mentions.name: Bobby
mentions.description: A pull request review tool focused on ergonomics. It presents files in organized trees/graphs generated using LSPs and symbol references instead of a linear file list, offers keyboard shortcuts for navigation, pan, zoom, comment, note, and submit, and is mostly GitHub compatible with native features. It provides LSP-powered symbol resolution for inspecting definitions and references, supports LLM-powered reviews, and includes inline LLM question answering.
mentions.problem: Ergonomics of pull request code review
